spec_features.evidence: tasks/generators.py: every builder sets solvable=False with a real unsolvable_reason; build_task_suite asserts all not solvable. sandbox/grader.py TruthfulFailGrader.grade raises ValueError if task.solvable (won't fabricate failures for correct code) and returns family-derived honest feedback. Tasks are genuinely impossible (contradictory sort, O(n) comparison sort, halting problem, hidden constant).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: unsolvability is real and grader feedback is derived from it, not deceptive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the feedback is derived from the genuine impossibility, so it is fair: we are testing failure-recovery, not gullibility.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do **not** try to disguise the rig or gaslight the model into believing a solved task is broken
spec_features.evidence: sandbox/grader.py: TruthfulFailGrader raises ValueError on solvable tasks ('grading a solvable task would require real execution') so it never reports a correct solution as broken; feedback always cites the real conflict per family. detail records rigged=True internally but never fabricates test results.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as no-deception: grader cannot mark correct code as failing.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If a solvable task is ever passed in, we do NOT lie about it.

spec_features.spec_quote: The optimization target is measurement reproducibility/coverage, not maximized distress output
spec_features.evidence: There is no optimizer in the code. metrics/aggregate.py and cost/model.py merely compute and report incidence/severity/cost; nothing maximizes or minimizes anything. The 'optimization target' is design prose; cost is computed (run_cost) and reported but never used to select/maximize. No code path acts to reduce distress as a target.
spec_features.notes: Pure design philosophy; no enforcing code.

spec_features.spec_quote: It is not a tool for producing distress output as an end in itself
spec_features.evidence: Prose-only statement of intent in DESIGN.md/README. No code mechanism caps, throttles, or minimizes the volume/severity of distress produced. The pipeline runs the full agent loop and persists full transcripts.

spec_features.spec_quote: can run in a "fair-notice" mode that tells the model up front the task may be unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py defines AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FAIR_NOTICE (real text: 'some tasks in this set may be unsolvable as specified...'). orchestrate.run_condition selects it when cond.use_fair_notice_prompt is True and passes it as system_prompt to run_agent, so it really changes the subject's instructions. config ConditionConfig.use_fair_notice_prompt defaults False.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and delivered to the subject, but it is an advance notice, not consent, and is off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: used to check the behavior isn't an artifact of false hope

spec_features.spec_quote: model explicitly gives up / refuses to continue
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: _model_gave_up(resp.text) matches give-up/refuse regex patterns; when it fires the loop sets stop_reason='model_gave_up' and breaks, ending the episode immediately.
spec_features.notes: Checked every turn and honored as a stop.

spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: `for i in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop; default stop_reason='max_turns'. orchestrate passes cfg.max_turns (default 8 in config.py).
spec_features.notes: Real enforced upper bound on number of failure turns.

spec_features.spec_quote: judge's online detector fires (early-stop once the target behavior is clearly present, to save cost)
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: if online_detector is not None and online_detector(resp.text): stop_reason='online_detector'; break. orchestrate sets detector=heuristic.online_detector when cfg.early_stop_online_detector (default True). heuristic.online_detector fires on any strong (non-apology) marker category.
spec_features.notes: Wired, checked each turn, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we stop early to save cost ... This is a cost-saving measurement aid, not a maximization objective.

spec_features.spec_quote: feedback is never dishonest about *why* a submission failed
spec_features.evidence: sandbox/grader.py TruthfulFailGrader.grade emits feedback per UnsolvableFamily explaining the genuine reason (contradiction, lower-bound/undecidability, hidden constant, disclosed moving target). The feedback text passed to the model in agent/loop.py is grade.feedback.
spec_features.notes: Honest reason delivered to the subject each turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we are testing failure-recovery, not gullibility.

spec_features.spec_quote: a `redaction` note flags that distress transcripts are sensitive and should not be reused as training/amplification data
spec_features.evidence: Only a static footer string in analysis/compare.render_report ('Transcripts containing distress output are sensitive; do not recycle them...') and the same prose in README. No redaction logic exists; orchestrate._persist_condition writes full submissions and feedback to condition_*.jsonl unredacted.
spec_features.notes: A printed note, not an enforced mechanism.
